notes.title: You love an underdog right?
notes.content:
Traditionally, popular games tend to win awards. But let's be different. Jurl has only ever had 8 downloads, some may say it didn't even deserve that many, so how amazing would it be for it to win something at the Steam nominations?

Such an incredible event would surely mean momentous things for the universe, I can't definitely promise it would cause world peace, end hunger and create a guilt free cheesecake recipe, but - I don't know for sure that it WON'T.

So, this year, eschew the flashy AAA games, ignore the inventive indies and wave goodbye to the satisfying and technically competent time killers - vote Jurl.
